notes.title: Quick Start Added!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30629545/ebe6f20daf65a924bbab6bfdc44b37c228afa89d.png[/img]

Quick start gives the ability to start a game at the beginning of the invasion phase! This function becomes available after two scores have been obtained. It entirely skips the preparation phase, allowing the player to start in the action, but with the same equipment as the starting load-out.
